notes.title: Early access is available now!
notes.content:
[h3]Hi everyone! It is with great pleasure that we announce the release of Sir Galgano in EA!!![/h3]

[h3]Very soon, more news on this! Your help will contribute to the development of the game currently in progress! Let us know what you think and provide as much feedback as possible!!!... Medieval Tuscany is waiting for you...[/h3]

[h3]And thank you all for your patience in waiting!!![/h3]

[h3]PLEASE NOTE: You can play either with the keyboard or with your controller. Currently, if you use the controller, some actions like exiting the game, pausing, or navigating the game menu need to be done with the mouse. It is planned that in future updates, you'll be able to perform all actions using only the controller.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41288049/4c8e4eea9cd4b764bc146b4c18d846aef7e1ae06.png[/img]

notes.title: EA!
notes.content: [h3]Hi! There has been a bit of a delay in reviewing the version to be published as an EA! Unfortunately, the release will likely happen in the first week of May! Sorry about that! As soon as it's available, we will make sure to release it![/h3]

[h3]Hello everyone! And here is the inventory! Here you can buy/sell from the merchant, equip, and manage the inventory! Each item has a description and its characteristics (armor class, required strength, price, etc.) depending on the selected gear![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41288049/70da001fa7a24446f757caacbb0905ce71c2a7cb.png[/img]

[h3]Swords, shields, pieces of armor... the merchant will always have them available and more and more![/h3]
[h3]
Very soon, but very soon in EA![/h3]

notes.title: YOU can configure the buttons
notes.content:
[h3]Hi!
In Early Access version [b]YOU can configure the buttons on your keyboard or your controller[/b], so:
- do you like to play with controller? choose the style of the button as you prefer!
- [i]"my controller doesn't work!"[/i] Sometimes Unity doesn't recognize the controller! With this software https://github.com/nefarius/DsHidMini Unity recognize the controller. [u](we haven't developed this SW and we don't take any responsibility on its use and we don't know if there are other SW that solve the problem, feel free to use it or not[/u])
- [i]"I don't want to use this SW to solve the problem!"[/i] ok! take your keyboard and play!
In any case, whichever choice you make, equip yourself the medieval tuscany legends are waiting for you![/h3]

notes.title: ...moving the release date...
notes.content:
Hi!
[b]For bureaucratic reasons (we dont' want to bore you about these things!!!) we must unfortunately move the release date for the early access in april 2025.[/b]
But this snag at the same time this is allows us to add other details (especially into inventory) and best test all the levels.
We hope to release the early access from the mid-april until end april.
We look forward see you play and get feedback!
[b]Stay tuned! Sir Galgano is coming.....[/b]

notes.title: INFO & UPDATE ABOUT EARLY ACCESS
notes.content:
Hi there!
Some info & update about early access.
We are sorry and we ask wait a little longer but we decide to move release date for the early access in march 2025 because we want to add more levels of the game in early access compared to what we planned. 
All this will contribute to try and play more aspect of the game with greater depth while development go on until the complete version. 
Needless to say that your feedback, suggestions and criticism are valuable, we do read it and helped us to correct and improve the game. 
We hope and count on you in the upcoming release! Again a big thank you to everyone!
[b]Stay tuned! If as we hope we succeed to release before march we will write here![/b]

notes.title: Info Devlog
notes.content:
Hi there! we developed three magic skill that you can see in this short video!
We think it's fun to use some magic skill and we developed one spell useful each different circumstance.
The first spell is Flame Blade, this you know! This spell inflicts fire damage when hit enemies and you can take out enemies faster...if you hit them!
The second is Blow Devastating! We would like to give the opportunity to attack enemies from distance. This is the only way because Sir Galgano doesn't use throwing weapons.
The last is Thunderwave! When surrounded by your enemies, what can you do? This spell pushes enemies away while dealing damage. Very useful!
Take a look and let us know what do you think about!

[previewyoutube=MRUnKZDei6Q;full][/previewyoutube]
